references.text: God promises to bless Abraham, and this blessing cannot be reversed by humans.
God's blessing on Abraham is irrevocable and confirmed with an oath.
Isaac confirms that the blessing he gave Jacob cannot be taken back - 'he shall be blessed'.
God instructs Balaam that Israel is blessed, which prepares this statement.
Balaam acknowledges that he cannot curse whom God has not cursed.
God declares that no one can reverse what He does.
The Lord's plan stands firm and cannot be overturned.
God's gracious gifts and calling are irrevocable.
